author: Gareth Kavanagh
title: Paid artist open call for Paradise Towers 2 backup strips
content: Paid artist open call out! Yes, we're looking for new artists for the backup strips on Paradise Towers 2, out this February. Build high for happiness! Contact via DM or check @cutawaycomics for full details; applications via portfolio email or DM.

author: young.onion
title: Hiring kawaii artists for stationery collection
content: 🎨 WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! ✨🐾 Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! 🥰 We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! 📓✍️💖 If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens, let’s make something magical together. ✨ How to apply: 1️⃣ Make sure you're following us [@young.onion]! 2️⃣ Drop a comment below with your favorite emoji and tag an artist friend who needs to see this! 👇 3️⃣ Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! 📂✨ You can also mail us info@youngonion.in Can't wait to see your cute art! Let’s create something amazing! 🌸💫

author: eunoians
title: Immediate openings for illustrators and more
content: IMMEDIATE OPENINGS - ILLUSTRATORS | COMPOSITORS | EDITORS | AI EXPERTS We’re looking for creative people with an eye for detail and a passion for bringing ideas to life. Illustrators: Figma knowledge is a plus. Send your profile to join@eunoians.com. Applications and queries via email only. No calls or WhatsApp messages, please.

author: Phil Falco
title: Paid comic work for Transphoria anthology
content: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply to be a Writer or Artist in the next volume of Ringo Award-winning comic anthology: TRANSPHORIA! No previous experience required (we love working with industry veterans AND fresh faces). Absolutely no costs to apply/contribute. Paid work for accepted contributors. Creators retain rights to their stories! Application Deadline: December 21, 2026! Link in @philfalcowrites bio!

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring comic artists, writers and more for studio projects
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️ We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: -Name, general location -Position applying for -Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples -Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-) -Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary) -Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work -Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc) -Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use) -Other notable experience / specializations *NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE* ‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️
